# Clinical Consequence

This folder contains documentation on the direct impact of healthcare operational metrics and delays on patient outcomes. The available evidence specifically connects surgical wait times to severe negative health outcomes, emphasizing that tracking these metrics is a matter of patient survival rather than just administrative efficiency. Currently, the data in this area is thin, consisting of a single claim tied to a specific clinical quality indicator regarding operating room delays.

## Pages

- [[clinical-consequence|Clinical Consequence]] — Documents the direct impact of surgical wait times on patient survival and hospitalization length, currently limited to a single claim tied to Indikator 4x.
